translation: Took place in posad Serock, 28 June 1890, 3 PM. Appeared personally Jankiel Borensztejn, carpenter, 34[?], and Nuta Roznowicz[?], shopkeeper, 30, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that this day at 8 AM died in posad Serock a child of male sex, aged five days [no name inked], son of Fajwel Zylbersztam[?] and his wife Czyta[?] nee Skurnik, residing in posad Serock. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of this child, this act was read to the witnesses and signed by us and by them.
